# **RESULTS**
## Diversity Calculation by Shannon Diversity Index

```{r Shanon Diversity}
# 1) Clean and prepare data
#    (expects a data frame `Diversity` with columns: Meter, Tree_species)
# =========================
diversity <- Diversity %>%
  mutate(
    meter = as.character(Meter),
    # normalize species text
    Tree_Species = str_squish(Tree_species),
    Tree_Species = str_to_title(Tree_Species)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(meter), !is.na(Tree_Species), Tree_Species != "")

# ===========================================
# 2) Count abundance and make community matrix
# ===========================================
counts <- diversity %>%
  count(meter, Tree_Species, name = "abundance")

comm_mat <- counts %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Tree_Species,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("meter") %>%
  as.matrix()
# ---- Helper: unbiased Simpson for an abundance vector ----
simpson_unbiased <- function(x) {
  N <- sum(x)
  if (N <= 1) return(NA_real_)
  1 - sum(x * (x - 1)) / (N * (N - 1))
}
# ===========================
# 3) OVERALL (pooled) indices
# ===========================
overall_counts      <- colSums(comm_mat)                      # totals per species
overall_S           <- specnumber(overall_counts)             # richness
overall_H           <- diversity(overall_counts, index = "shannon", base = exp(1))
overall_evenness_J  <- as.numeric(overall_H / log(overall_S)) # Pielou J'
overall_Simpson_u   <- simpson_unbiased(overall_counts)       # unbiased Simpson

overall_summary <- tibble(
  metric = c("Shannon_H", "Richness_S", "Evenness_J", "Simpson_unbiased"),
  value  = c(overall_H, overall_S, overall_evenness_J, overall_Simpson_u)
)

# ==========================================
# 4) DIVERSITY PER METER (Shannon + unbiased Simpson)
# ==========================================
H_per_meter         <- diversity(comm_mat, index = "shannon", base = exp(1))
S_per_meter         <- specnumber(comm_mat, MARGIN = 1)
J_per_meter         <- as.numeric(H_per_meter / log(pmax(S_per_meter, 1)))
Simpson_u_per_meter <- apply(comm_mat, 1, simpson_unbiased)

diversity_by_meter <- tibble(
  meter                   = rownames(comm_mat),
  Shannon_H               = as.numeric(H_per_meter),
  Richness_S              = as.integer(S_per_meter),
  Evenness_J              = J_per_meter,
  Simpson_unbiased_cal    = as.numeric(Simpson_u_per_meter)
) %>% arrange(as.numeric(meter))

# ======================================================
# 5) Species × meter: counts and proportions per meter
# ======================================================
species_by_meter_counts <- as_tibble(comm_mat, rownames = "meter")

species_by_meter_props <- species_by_meter_counts %>%
  mutate(total_at_meter = rowSums(across(-meter))) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(meter, total_at_meter),
                ~ ifelse(total_at_meter > 0, .x / total_at_meter, 0),
                .names = "{.col}_prop"))

# ============================================================
# 6) “Spatial diversity” for each species across all meters
#    (distribution of each species across meters)
# ============================================================
# Shannon spatial (meters as categories)
spatial_Shannon_by_species <- apply(comm_mat, 2, function(x){
  tot <- sum(x); if (tot == 0) return(NA_real_)
  p <- x / tot
  diversity(p, index = "shannon", base = exp(1))
})

# Unbiased Simpson spatial (using counts across meters)
spatial_Simpson_u_by_species <- apply(comm_mat, 2, simpson_unbiased)

species_spatial_summary <- tibble(
  species                   = names(spatial_Shannon_by_species),
  spatial_Shannon_H         = as.numeric(spatial_Shannon_by_species),
  spatial_Simpson_unbiased  = as.numeric(spatial_Simpson_u_by_species),
  total_abundance           = as.numeric(overall_counts)
) %>% arrange(desc(total_abundance))

# ===================
# 7) View
# ===================
overall_summary                 # Overall site-level indices (Shannon + unbiased Simpson)
diversity_by_meter              # Per-meter indices
species_by_meter_counts         # Counts per species per meter
species_by_meter_props          # Proportions per species per meter
species_spatial_summary         # Spatial indices per species
```

## Barplot 

```{r}
# ---------- Present-day (species_by_meter_counts) ----------
present_long <- species_by_meter_counts %>%
  pivot_longer(-meter, names_to = "species_raw", values_to = "count") %>%
  group_by(species_raw) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(as.numeric(count), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      species_raw %in% c("Red Spruce","White Spruce","Spruce") ~ "Spruce",
      species_raw %in% c("Yellow Birch","Paper Birch","Birch") ~ "Birch",
      str_detect(species_raw, regex("ash", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Ash",
      str_detect(species_raw, regex("choke\\s*cherry|cherry", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Choke Cherry",
      TRUE ~ species_raw
    ),
    forest_type = "Present day"
  ) %>%
  group_by(species, forest_type) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

# ---------- Pre-settlement (ID$Prelim_ID) ----------
pre_counts <- ID %>%
  transmute(species_raw = str_to_title(str_squish(str_replace_all(Prelim_ID, "[^A-Za-z ]", " ")))) %>%
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      str_detect(species_raw, "Spruce") ~ "Spruce",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Birch") ~ "Birch",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Maple") ~ "Maple",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Larch") ~ "Larch",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Fir") ~ "Fir",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Ash") ~ "Ash",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Shadbush|Amelanchier") ~ "Shadbush",
      str_detect(species_raw, "Cherry") ~ "Choke Cherry",
      TRUE ~ species_raw
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(species) & species != "") %>%      
  count(species, name = "count") %>%
  mutate(forest_type = "Pre-settlement")

# ---------- Combine, order, plot ----------
plot_df <- bind_rows(present_long, pre_counts) %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(species = fct_reorder(species, total, .desc = TRUE))
##
#font_add("calibril", "C:/kyoshiinari/Downloads/calibril.ttf")
## --- plot (no grid, legend right) ---
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = species, y = count, fill = forest_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  labs(
    x = "Tree species",
    y = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans", face = "plain"),  # uses Calibri-like clean font
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),  # removes all gridlines
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "plain")
  )
```

```{r}
## Counts of each taxon in the pre-settlement forest
counts <- c(
  Birch        = 34,
  Beech        = 17,
  Larch        = 1,
  Spruce       = 8,
  Canada_yew   = 4,
  Pine         = 5,
  White_pine   = 1
)

# Total individuals
N <- sum(counts)

# Relative abundances
p <- counts / N

# Species richness (S)
richness <- length(counts)

# Shannon diversity (natural log)
shannon <- -sum(p * log(p))

# Unbiased Simpson diversity:
# lambda_unb = Σ n_i (n_i - 1) / [N (N - 1)]
lambda_unb <- sum(counts * (counts - 1)) / (N * (N - 1))
simpson_unbiased <- 1 - lambda_unb

# Pielou’s evenness J = H / ln(S)
evenness <- shannon / log(richness)

# Put results in a small table
div_results <- data.frame(
  N_total          = N,
  Richness_S       = richness,
  Shannon_H        = shannon,
  Simpson_unbiased = simpson_unbiased,
  Evenness_Pielou  = evenness
)

print(div_results)

```

```{r}
## Species counts
present <- c(
  Birch = 17,
  Beech = 0,
  Larch = 0,
  Spruce = 65,
  Canada_yew = 0,
  Pine = 0,
  Choke_cherry = 2,
  American_mountain_ash = 51,
  Balsam_fir = 4,
  Speckled_alder = 3
)

pre_settlement <- c(
  Birch = 29,
  Beech = 13,
  Larch = 3,
  Spruce = 7,
  Canada_yew = 4,
  Pine = 19,
  Choke_cherry = 1,
  American_mountain_ash = 0,
  Balsam_fir = 1,
  Speckled_alder = 0
)

## Functions for indices

shannon_H <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  p <- x / sum(x)
  -sum(p * log(p))          # natural log
}

simpson_unbiased <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  N <- sum(x)
  1 - sum(x * (x - 1)) / (N * (N - 1))
}

evenness_J <- function(x) {
  S <- sum(x > 0)           # richness
  H <- shannon_H(x)
  H / log(S)
}

richness_S <- function(x) sum(x > 0)

## Calculate for each forest

present_results <- list(
  N         = sum(present),
  richness  = richness_S(present),
  shannon   = shannon_H(present),
  simpson_u = simpson_unbiased(present),
  evenness  = evenness_J(present)
)

pre_settlement_results <- list(
  N         = sum(pre_settlement),
  richness  = richness_S(pre_settlement),
  shannon   = shannon_H(pre_settlement),
  simpson_u = simpson_unbiased(pre_settlement),
  evenness  = evenness_J(pre_settlement)
)

present_results
pre_settlement_results

results <- rbind(
  Present = unlist(present_results),
  Pre_settlement = unlist(pre_settlement_results)
)

results


```

```{r}
## -----------------------------
## 1. Data
## -----------------------------
present <- c(
  Birch                  = 17,
  Beech                  = 0,
  Larch                  = 0,
  Spruce                 = 65,
  Canada_yew             = 0,
  Pine                   = 0,
  Choke_cherry           = 2,
  American_mountain_ash  = 51,
  Balsam_fir             = 4,
  Speckled_alder         = 3
)

pre_settlement <- c(
  Birch                  = 29,
  Beech                  = 13,
  Larch                  = 3,
  Spruce                 = 7,
  Canada_yew             = 4,
  Pine                   = 19,
  Choke_cherry           = 1,
  American_mountain_ash  = 0,
  Balsam_fir             = 1,
  Speckled_alder         = 0
)

## -----------------------------
## 2. Diversity functions
## -----------------------------
shannon_H <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  p <- x / sum(x)
  -sum(p * log(p))   # natural log
}

simpson_unbiased <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  N <- sum(x)
  1 - sum(x * (x - 1)) / (N * (N - 1))
}

evenness_J <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]
  S <- length(x)
  H <- shannon_H(x)
  H / log(S)
}

## -----------------------------
## 3. Permutation test function
## -----------------------------
perm_diversity_test <- function(counts1, counts2, nperm = 9999, seed = 123) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  all_counts <- counts1 + counts2
  species    <- rep(names(all_counts), times = all_counts)

  N1 <- sum(counts1)
  N2 <- sum(counts2)
  Ntot <- N1 + N2

  # observed values
  H1_obs  <- shannon_H(counts1)
  H2_obs  <- shannon_H(counts2)
  S1_obs  <- simpson_unbiased(counts1)
  S2_obs  <- simpson_unbiased(counts2)
  E1_obs  <- evenness_J(counts1)
  E2_obs  <- evenness_J(counts2)

  dH_obs <- H1_obs - H2_obs
  dS_obs <- S1_obs - S2_obs
  dE_obs <- E1_obs - E2_obs

  dH_perm <- numeric(nperm)
  dS_perm <- numeric(nperm)
  dE_perm <- numeric(nperm)

  for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
    idx1 <- sample.int(Ntot, size = N1, replace = FALSE)
    sp1  <- species[idx1]
    sp2  <- species[-idx1]

    tab1 <- table(sp1)
    tab2 <- table(sp2)

    # rebuild count vectors with same species order
    c1 <- integer(length(all_counts)); names(c1) <- names(all_counts)
    c2 <- integer(length(all_counts)); names(c2) <- names(all_counts)
    c1[names(tab1)] <- as.vector(tab1)
    c2[names(tab2)] <- as.vector(tab2)

    dH_perm[i] <- shannon_H(c1)          - shannon_H(c2)
    dS_perm[i] <- simpson_unbiased(c1)   - simpson_unbiased(c2)
    dE_perm[i] <- evenness_J(c1)         - evenness_J(c2)
  }

  p_H <- mean(abs(dH_perm) >= abs(dH_obs))
  p_S <- mean(abs(dS_perm) >= abs(dS_obs))
  p_E <- mean(abs(dE_perm) >= abs(dE_obs))

  list(
    observed = list(
      H_present  = H1_obs,  H_presettlement  = H2_obs,
      Simpson_present = S1_obs, Simpson_presettlement = S2_obs,
      Evenness_present = E1_obs, Evenness_presettlement = E2_obs
    ),
    diff_observed = c(Shannon = dH_obs, Simpson = dS_obs, Evenness = dE_obs),
    p_values = c(Shannon = p_H, Simpson = p_S, Evenness = p_E)
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## 4. Run the permutation test
## -----------------------------
perm_results <- perm_diversity_test(present, pre_settlement, nperm = 9999)
perm_results

```
